_definition.rule: between two contact runs: rise >= 2 mm OR lateral displacement (settled) >= 2 mm OR |yaw change (settled)| >= 2 deg -> a new placement attempt
_definition.contact: start of the run of [block bottom <= 1 mm above face_top & |vz| < 0.05 m/s & block centre within 2.5 cm of the face centre] that begins after the block has been >= 2 cm above the face since the grasp, lasts >= 0.1 s and is the run lasting until release (else the last run)
_definition.release: row after the last thumb/index fingertip contact with the carried block
_definition.grasp: both fingertips on the block for >= 0.3 s
superseded: n_segments_gated_a (rise >= 2 mm only, 15/2/1): candidate (a), not adopted
_definition.decided_by: 预测模型更新与RL训练同步, 2026-10-09

_official: n_realignments = n_segments_gated_b (coordinator 2026-10-09): consecutive contact runs count as separate placement attempts when, between them, the block rose >= 2 mm above the support face OR moved >= 2 mm laterally OR turned >= 2 deg (settled values: median of the next run's first 0.1 s)
